enhanced_atr_supertrend.name: Enhanced ATR Supertrend
enhanced_atr_supertrend.description: Advanced Supertrend with adaptive ATR multiplier and multiple smoothing methods. Signals on trend reversals with volatility confirmation.

LONG: Price closes above upper band (trend reversal)
SuperTrend flips from bearish to bullish
Trailing lower band becomes new support
SHORT: Price closes below lower band (trend reversal)
SuperTrend flips from bullish to bearish
Trailing upper band becomes new resistance
